prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that your truck is a rental. Respond to the committee.
response:
Mr. Chairman, Esteemed Grillmasters, Aunties of the Committee... I appreciate the opportunity to speak today. 

Let the record reflect that I am fully cooperating with this committee, but I sit before you today an innocent man, the victim of a vicious smear campaign likely orchestrated by my brother-in-law, Marcus, who is still upset I said his ribs tasted like boiled shoe leather in the summer of 2019.

The allegation that my 2008 Ford F-150 is a rental from Enterprise or U-Haul is not only categorically false, it is an insult to everything this Cookout stands for. 

I ask the committee to look at Exhibit A: the passenger-side door. You will clearly see a dent. Ask yourselves, gentlemen: would Hertz allow me to keep a vehicle with a dent perfectly shaped like a rogue horseshoe thrown by Uncle Earl at the 2014 family reunion? 

Look at Exhibit B: the interior. If you inspect the upholstery, you will find stains that carbon-date back to three separate generations of BBQ sauce. Sweet Baby Ray’s, Mr. Chairman. A rental car smells like industrial cleaner and false hope. My cabin smells of Black & Milds, Armor All, and the lingering spirit of the Isley Brothers playing through a blown left speaker. 

Do you know what is in the bed of my truck right now? Four folding chairs—two with the canvas slightly tearing—a cooler missing its drain plug, and half a bag of Kingsford charcoal that has been through three rainstorms. You cannot rent that kind of heritage! 

Are you now, or have you ever been, under the impression that I would show up to the function in an Avis mid-size SUV? No! I am a patriot of the pavement. I own the title, I pay the registration, and I am the sole proprietor of the tape holding the rearview mirror onto the windshield. 

I demand that these baseless accusations be struck from the record, and I yield the remainder of my time so I can get back to the spades table before my partner bids a blind nil. Thank you.
